issue.title: test_usage_only_changes_do_not_move_control_row fails intermittently as proc-indicator appears mid-test
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/ace/tui/test_usage_header.py::test_usage_only_changes_do_not_move_control_row`
- **Repro:** `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/test_usage_header.py -q -p no:randomly`

Fail/pass observations, fail rate, and serial vs parallel: full-file serial run failed 3 of 4 times on the same tree; a rerun on the unchanged tree passed (24 passed). The test also passes in isolation and in a 14-test prefix selection. Failure is `assert _top_bar_regions(page) == before` with `proc-indicator: (98, 1, 5, 1)` vs `(103, 1, 0, 0)` — an ACE-owned background proc appeared mid-test while usage variants were applied. The test pins claude/grok usage entries only, so the proc source is environmental or leaked from an earlier test in the same process, not the test's own fixtures. Observed while implementing plan:202609/muse_icon_visibility.md; the change under test (muse badge/color) is unrelated to proc counting. Possible kin: sase-120 and sase-121 (fail under load, pass in isolation).
